observations.text: Official manual: PRC-30 contains exactly four ordered transitions, stages 1 through 4; each stage output becomes the next stage input.
In PRC-30 stage 1, WIR-36 changes into BEX-55.
In PRC-30 stage 2, BEX-55 changes into TEK-62.
In PRC-30 stage 4, VOR-17 changes into terminal marker WIR-46.

In PRC-64 stage 4, GOL-31 changes into terminal marker PEL-29.

In PRC-35 stage 2, ZUM-82 changes into BIR-70.
In PRC-35 stage 4, JOT-60 changes into terminal marker KEL-64.
